fact: This document is the text of Lei n.º 34/2014 of 31 December 2014, the Lei do Direito à Informação, passed by the Assembleia da República to set the legal mechanisms for exercising the right to information; it applies to State bodies, direct and indirect administration, local authorities and private entities doing public-interest work or using public resources.
